one_liner: No Composio managed app. Register a free Xero web app in minutes; 5 orgs free, 50 on a paid plan, beyond that certification review.

start_today.summary: Create a free Xero account and a Web app at developer.xero.com, paste Composio's redirect URI, and connect up to 5 Xero organisations right away on the free Starter tier. Add a credit card to move to Core and connect up to 50, still without review.
limits_before_approval: Starter (default, free): 5 connections, 1,000 API calls per day per organisation. Before the March 2026 pricing change, uncertified apps got 25 connections free; older guides still say 25.
Core ($35 AUD/month, card required): 50 connections, 5,000 calls per day per organisation, 10 GB monthly egress then $2.40 AUD per GB. No certification needed.
Every tier: 60 calls per minute and 5 concurrent calls per organisation; 10,000 calls per minute across the app.
Each Xero organisation can connect at most five uncertified apps.
No Xero App Store listing below Plus. Journals endpoint, Xero Practice Manager API and bulk connections need Advanced plus a security assessment.
Access tokens last 30 minutes. Refresh tokens need the offline_access scope and expire after 60 days unused.

composio.note: Composio has no managed Xero app, so you must register your own and give Composio its client ID and secret. Register it as a Web app (not Mobile or Desktop), paste the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard, and remove deprecated broad scopes from the Composio auth config: Xero apps created on or after 2 March 2026 use granular scopes.

prerequisites.detail: Sign up for a free Xero account and use the Demo Company for development and testing.
Asked for when registering the app, alongside the app name and redirect URI.
Must be https (http://localhost only for testing). Copy it from the Composio dashboard.
Needed to move from Starter to Core ($35 AUD/month plus egress overage). Credit card is the only payment method.
Plus tier ($245 AUD/month) needs App Certification. Xero's guide lists ten active customer connections and a reviewer test account among the prerequisites.

prerequisites.item: Security assessment (more than 1,000 connections or premium APIs)
prerequisites.detail: Advanced and Enterprise tiers need an initial and annual security assessment.

steps.text: Sign up for a free Xero account and enable the Demo Company.
In Composio, create a Xero auth config with your own credentials and copy the redirect URI the dashboard shows.
At developer.xero.com > My Apps > New app, choose Web app (auth code flow). Enter the app name, company or application URL, and the Composio redirect URI.
Check the app name: it must be your product's real name and cannot include the word Xero (a certification checkpoint).
Generate the client secret and paste the client ID and secret into the Composio auth config.

Remove deprecated broad scopes from the Composio auth config (accounting.transactions, accounting.transactions.read, accounting.reports.read, accounting.journals.read) and use granular ones such as accounting.invoices.read, plus offline_access.
Check that the redirect URI in Xero exactly matches Composio's and the app type is Web app, not Mobile or Desktop.
Connect the Demo Company through Composio, finishing Xero consent within Composio's 10-minute window, then confirm the tenant ID via the connections endpoint.
Add payment details in the developer portal. That moves the app from Starter to Core: 50 connections and 5,000 calls per day per organisation.

phases.name: Certify for Plus (more than 50 connections)
phases.duration: Days of build work, then review

steps.text: Build the certification checkpoints: a setup page showing the connected tenant and its status, a disconnect button that calls DELETE on the connections endpoint, handling of disconnects from Xero's side, clear error messages, correct data handling, and account and tax mapping if you write data.
Request offline_access and only the scopes you can explain; add your login URL to the App Launcher field in the developer portal.
Onboard real customers. Xero's growth guide lists ten active customer connections as a certification prerequisite.
Whether Sign Up with Xero is required: one Xero page lists it as a prerequisite, two others call it optional. Ask your Developer Evangelist.
From Core, open your app in the developer portal and click Manage Plan to upgrade to Plus; certification happens as part of that upgrade.
Provide a test account if Xero asks for one.
Xero reviews the integration against the checkpoints. Xero publishes no timeline for this review.

phases.name: Scale past 1,000 connections (Advanced)
phases.duration: About 5 working days, then 5–10 working days review

steps.text: Complete the security self-assessment (about 5 working days of your time). Repeat it every year.
Xero reviews the answers in about 5–10 working days and may ask for remediation.

scopes.purpose: User identity for Sign In with Xero.
Refresh token so the agent keeps access after the 30-minute access token expires. Required for certification.
Invoices, credit notes, quotes, purchase orders, repeating invoices. Granular replacement for accounting.transactions.
Contacts; chart of accounts, tax rates and organisation settings.
Individual report scopes (profit and loss, balance sheet, aged, trial balance, etc.) replacing accounting.reports.read.
Deprecated broad scopes. Apps created on or after 2 March 2026 use granular scopes instead; older apps may keep these until September 2027. Remove them from Composio's auth config for new apps.
General ledger journals. Premium: Advanced tier, security assessment and use case approval.

approval.trigger: More than 50 connected organisations (Plus tier needs App Certification), a Xero App Store listing, or premium endpoints (Journals, Xero Practice Manager, bulk connections need Advanced, a security assessment and use case approval). Up to 50 connections need no review.
reviewers_check: Setup page showing the connected tenant and connection status, with connect and disconnect
Disconnect via DELETE on the connections endpoint; handling disconnects from Xero's side
Branding and naming: real product name, no "Xero" in the app name
App Launcher login URL set in the developer portal
Data integrity, account and payment mapping, and tax handling where relevant
Prerequisites such as ten active customer connections; a test account may be requested
approval.typical_wait: Xero publishes no certification timeline. Codat, an integration vendor, says becoming a Xero App Partner can take several months. The security assessment (Advanced tier) is official: about 5 working days to complete, then 5–10 working days for Xero's review.
common_rejections: App name includes "Xero" or misrepresents another company
Asking users for their Xero login instead of OAuth
Pop-up windows or new tabs in the auth flow
Relying on token expiry instead of deleting the connection

blockers.blocker: Xero error page: "unauthorized_client Unknown client or client not enabled".
blockers.fix: The client ID is wrong or the app is not enabled. Re-copy the client ID and check the app type is Web app.

blockers.blocker: Login or invalid-scope errors when connecting through Composio.
blockers.fix: Remove deprecated broad scopes (accounting.transactions, accounting.transactions.read, accounting.reports.read, accounting.journals.read) from the auth config and reconnect.
The Xero consent step was not finished within Composio's 10-minute window. Restart the flow.
Starter is capped at 5. Add payment details to move to Core.
Connections are capped at the tier maximum until you meet the next tier's requirements: certify and move to Plus.

blockers.blocker: A customer's Xero organisation already has several uncertified apps connected.
blockers.fix: Each organisation can connect at most five uncertified apps; certified apps have no such limit. Certification removes the problem.

blockers.blocker: Older guides say uncertified apps get 25 free connections.
blockers.fix: That was the pre-2026 rule. Since the 2 March 2026 pricing change, Starter allows 5 and Core 50.
Request offline_access and refresh at least every 60 days; unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days.

blockers.blocker: Planning a single-organisation Custom Connection instead.
blockers.fix: From 1 December 2026 Xero stops new Custom Connection apps and subscriptions. Use a Web app.

blockers.blocker: Using Xero data to train or fine-tune models.
blockers.fix: Xero's Developer Platform Terms prohibit using API data to train any AI or ML model, and ban bots or browser extensions that simulate user actions.

agent_can: Pick minimal granular scopes for the Composio tools you use and remove deprecated broad scopes
Check the redirect URI matches exactly, uses https, and the app type is Web app
Check the app name against Xero's naming rule
Run a test connection on the Demo Company and confirm the tenant ID
Build or check the certification checkpoints (connection page, disconnect, error handling, App Launcher URL)
Draft scope justifications and certification application answers
Estimate monthly connections and API egress to pick a tier, and watch the connection cap
you_must: Create the Xero account and register the app
Accept the Xero Developer Platform Terms (including the AI training ban)
Add a credit card and pay tier fees above Starter
Onboard real customers to reach the certification prerequisites
Apply for Plus via Manage Plan and provide a reviewer test account
Complete the annual security assessment for Advanced and above
provider_controls: Certification review and tier moves above Core
Use case approval for Journals, Xero Practice Manager and bulk connections
Pricing, connection caps and rate limits

uncertain: Certification wait: Xero publishes no timeline. The only figure found is Codat's "several months" to become an App Partner; no first-hand developer reports were found. Treat weeks to months as an estimate.

Whether Core needs App Certification: the pricing table and the tier FAQ show only a payment method for Core, but FAQ item 22 mentions an "App certification" requirement for the Core, Plus, Advanced and Enterprise tiers.
Whether Sign Up with Xero is required for certification: the growth guide lists it as a prerequisite; the certification checkpoints and OAuth overview call it optional.
Security assessment scope: the pricing table requires it only for Advanced and Enterprise, but the older security FAQ says all app partners need one to be certified.
Uncertified apps per organisation: the limits page says five; the Custom Integration FAQ still says an org can have 2 uncertified apps.
Whether the Xero Demo Company counts toward the 5-connection Starter cap is not stated in current docs.

Composio's default Xero scope list was not visible in the docs we could read; its knowledge base says to remove deprecated broad scopes, which suggests some defaults may fail for apps created after 2 March 2026.
